about: Components of a creature that GK.Stage.Verify does not count as dirt, each with the reason and how it is checked. kept: the engine creates it at a creature's first use of a system, never removes it, and it then holds its default - it is not dirt while it holds that, and Verify lists it under `kept`; `any` marks one that holds the game's record of its last request, not dirt whatever it holds. passing: the engine removes it by itself a moment later (a timer of its own); Verify counts it as a moment's matter (`pending`) and lists it under `passing`. A component whose engine name ends in OneFrameComponent lives one tick and is passing without an entry. docs/contracts/lua-api.md 14.

esv::boost::StoryRequestsComponent.why: created at a creature's first Osi.AddBoosts and kept; Boosts holds the boost requests in flight and is empty once they are applied

esv::death::KillerComponent.why: created on a creature at its first kill and kept; Killers holds the creatures it killed while they exist, and is empty once they are gone (read on the host after its kills were deleted, and on a spawned goblin that killed another)

esv::unsheath::DefaultComponent.why: created at a creature's first weapon request (a fight, the player's toggle, Osi.SetWeaponUnsheathed) and kept; esv::unsheath::DefaultSystem writes field_0 (a StatsUnsheathState) at every request - the player's toggle writes 3, Osi.SetWeaponUnsheathed(1) writes 2, a fight 1 - so it holds what the last request wrote, and the stage's own restore of the weapons writes it too (traced with the systems tracked: research/studies/weapon-in-hand.md, section 7)

esv::action_resource::CooldownTrackingCo.why: added when a turn resource is spent out of combat and removed once the game has recharged it, a round later

esv::unsheath::CombatJoiningComponent.why: added when a creature joins a fight (the weapon is drawn) and removed when the draw has played

esv::unsheath::CombatLeavingComponent.why: added when a creature leaves a fight (the weapon is put away) and removed when the sheathing has played

esv::unsheath::SpellAnimationLifetimeCom.why: held while an attack's or a spell's animation keeps the weapon out

esv::unsheath::SpellAnimationConcludedCo.why: added when that animation ends; the game puts the weapon away out of combat and removes it a moment later

eoc::spell_cast::IsCastingComponent.why: held while a cast is under way

esv::combat::JoiningComponent.why: held while a creature is being added to a fight

ls::animation::AnimationSetUpdateRequest.why: a request to change the animation set, taken off a tick later

esv::ServerTimelineActorDataComponent.why: held while a timeline (a dialogue or a reaction) plays the creature

eoc::SyncedTimelineActorControlComponent.why: held while a timeline plays the creature

eoc::timeline::ActorVisualDataComponent.why: held while a timeline plays the creature

esv::hit::UnresolvedHitNotificationCompo.why: held until the hit it notifies of is resolved, a tick or two
